title: Compliance sparring notes — SOC2 readiness probe
content:
Purpose: quick brain-dump for week-of sprint pairing with Ellie and Liam. Not polished — literal scratchpad for collecting small tasks, assumptions, and mini-queries to run against systems before next review.

High-level goal:
- Reach a consistent evidence pattern for 6 high-risk controls by end of Q1: access reviews, secrets rotation, infra change approvals, incident logging, backup/restore, deployment separation.

Quick risk scoring heuristic (for triage):
- Likelihood: 1-5 (how often the event occurs)
- Impact: 1-5 (regulatory/customer impact + restore cost)
- Score = L * I (prioritize >8)

Immediate TODOs (actionable, one-line):
- Run: git grep -n "rotate-key" in infra repo to find scheduled rotation hooks; log results to evidence/rotations.md (noor)
- Query: SELECT count(*) FROM auth.events WHERE event_type='login' AND success=false AND timestamp > now()-interval '30 days' (Liam) — attach anonymized sample to ticket
- Export list of users in org-admin Google group (Ellie) — put CSV in private evidence folder
- Pull list of deployed images from k8s clusters (staging+prod) and map to deploy approvers (noor)
- Slack search: from:@deploy-bot "approved by"  in #prod-cicd last 90d — capture 10 examples (Ellie)

Control mapping rough notes (working names):
- C-AUTH-01: Identity lifecycle (onboarding/offboarding) => owners: eng-platform + ppl-ops; evidence: joiner/leaver tracker, HR export, Okta deprovision logs, weekly audit csv
- C-SEC-ROT-02: Secrets rotation => owners: infra; evidence: rotation schedule in repo, KMS key versions, vault audit logs, rotator CronJob outputs
- C-CHG-03: Change approvals => owners: release-eng + platform-eng; evidence: PR approvals, codeowner edits, deployment approvals recorded by deploy-bot, change window calendar invites
- C-LOG-04: Logical logging & monitoring => owners: sre/observability; evidence: alerting rules, retained logs (7/30/365), sample incident ticket with timeline
- C-BACKUP-05: Backups & restores => owners: infra; evidence: runbook + restore test results (last 90d), snapshot list, S3 lifecycle policy
- C-NET-06: Network separation/privilege => owners: security + platform; evidence: VPC peering docs, restricted SG lists, bastion access logs

Notes-to-self / awkward edges:
- Our "deploy approver" flow is partly in GitHub and partly in deploy-bot metadata. Need a small script to join data sources; could live in infra/tools/deploy-evidence.sh.
- Need to define a consistent evidence filename schema: team_controlid_YYYYMMDD.txt (so auditors don't ask for ten variants)
- For secrets rotation — confirm if any service uses long-lived static tokens (I think billing-reporter uses a token in secrets manager). Flagging as high-likelihood.

Interview q's to ask eng leads (draft):
- How often do you do scheduled user access reviews? Who signs off?
- Describe the path of a production deployment from PR -> prod (who approves, where is approval recorded?).
- When was the last time you exercised a restore from backup? Who led it?
- Which services still have human-managed secrets vs automated KMS-backed keys?

Evidence collection pattern (proposal):
1) Create evidence/ folder per control in shared drive (evidence/C-AUTH-01/ etc)
2) Put a README.md in each with: what the artifact is, why it satisfies control, extraction command, who to ask
3) Minimal redaction guidance: redact PII, keep correlation ids and minimal timestamps

Small scripts / commands to run (notes):
- Okta export: okta-client users export --group "org-admins" > evidence/org-admins-20260301.csv
- Vault audit tail: sudo journalctl -u vault | grep "rotate" | tail -n 200 > evidence/vault-rotations.txt
- K8s images: kubectl get pods -A -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}{"\t"}{.spec.containers[*].image}{"\n"}{end}' > evidence/k8s-images-20260301.txt

Open questions / blockers:
- Legal wants a retention policy for evidence artifacts — do we keep all raw exports or only summarized extracts? (ask legal how long for pre-audit materials)
- Who will be the formal control owner for C-LOG-04? SRE ops says "observability team" but they need a named person.
- How to handle 3rd-party services that store logs (segment, sentry) — we need export proofs or vendor attestations.

Misc thoughts / heuristics:
- For auditor comfort, prefer 3 different types of artifact per control: config (docs), operational record (logs/tickets), and person (owner signoff).
- Use timestamps in evidence files and include a small note: "extracted-by: <name>". Small human touches reduce follow-ups.

Next meetings:
- 2026-03-07 10:00 internal sync with Ellie + Liam (30m) — scope mapping for C-AUTH-01 and C-SEC-ROT-02
- 2026-03-09 15:00 chat with release-eng to walk deployment flow (noor + samira)

Rough evidence filenames I will create this week:
- evidence/C-SEC-ROT-02/rotations-vault-20260301.txt
- evidence/C-CHG-03/deploy-approvals-samples-20260228.txt
- evidence/C-BACKUP-05/restore-test-summary-20260220.txt

Random scratch: if we can automate the export-to-evidence path (small lambda or GH action), we cut audit prep time by ~40% (guestimate).

End of scratchpad. Will tidy into a proper checklist after the 03/07 sync.
